script.text: The second Shadow Rider, Camula, defeated Dr. Crowler and Zane – taking both their Spirit Keys and trapping their souls into dolls. It was up to Jaden to put an end to her madness.
All right, Camula. I'm here for my friends' souls! And I’m not leavin’ ‘til I get ‘em!
Truth be told, dear... You’re not leaving here ever again! Not a single one of you are!
Camula, get your game on! And I mean on high! Cuz when someone duels my pals and turns their souls into some dolls, it puts me in a bad mood!
And let me tell you something....I don't care! Hahaha!
Maybe this will change your mind!
